introduction: This specification governs the DuckDB reader/writer split for the agent-fox project, enforcing that read-only call sites open `knowledge.duckdb` with `read_only=True` and that write operations are removed from the `assemble_context` read path and moved to the orchestrator startup sequence.

glossary.KnowledgeDB: The internal DuckDB connection class; keeps its `read_only` default for test and internal use.
glossary._migrate_legacy_files: An idempotent function that migrates legacy `review.md` / `verification.md` files into DuckDB records; must be moved to orchestrator startup.
glossary.af code: The CLI command (`af/code.py`) that loads and displays the current plan; performs only SELECT operations.
glossary.af findings: The CLI command (`af/findings.py`) that lists and optionally dismisses findings; requires read-write when dismissing.
glossary.af plan --verify: The verification subcommand of `af plan` that checks the plan against the database; performs only SELECT operations.
glossary.af standup: The CLI command (`af/standup.py`) that displays standup information; already uses `read_only=True`.
glossary.assemble_context: A function in `agentfox/session/context.py` that builds the session context from the database; currently performs opportunistic writes that must be extracted.
glossary.compute_phases: A function that derives execution phases from the plan graph using only SELECT queries.
glossary.fix/analyzer.py: The module `agentfox/fix/analyzer.py` that queries active findings; performs only SELECT operations.
glossary.index_errata_from_markdown: An idempotent function that indexes errata markdown files into DuckDB; must be moved to orchestrator startup.
glossary.knowledge.duckdb: The DuckDB database file used by agent-fox to store plans, findings, session outcomes, and errata.
glossary.load_plan: A function that reads the current plan from DuckDB for display.
glossary.make check: The project's top-level CI command that runs linting and all tests.
glossary.nightshift: The long-running orchestrator process (`af/nightshift.py`) that holds a DuckDB write lock during multi-session runs.
glossary.open_knowledge_store: The public factory function in agent-fox that opens a DuckDB connection to knowledge.duckdb; its `read_only` parameter will be made required (no default).
glossary.orchestrator startup: The initialization phase of the nightshift orchestrator or engine runner that executes before any sessions are dispatched.
glossary.plan_edges: DuckDB table storing directed edges between plan nodes.
glossary.plan_meta: DuckDB table storing metadata associated with a plan.
glossary.plan_nodes: DuckDB table storing individual nodes of the task plan.
glossary.query_active_findings: A function in `fix/analyzer.py` that retrieves active findings via SELECT.
glossary.conn: A `duckdb.DuckDBPyConnection` instance passed to functions that need database access; may be read-only or read-write depending on the call site.
glossary.read_only: The boolean keyword argument passed to `open_knowledge_store` or `KnowledgeDB` that opens the DuckDB file in read-only mode, allowing concurrent readers.
glossary.read_only=False: Keyword argument value passed to `open_knowledge_store` to open the database in read-write mode, allowing INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations.
glossary.read_only=True: Keyword argument value passed to `open_knowledge_store` to open the database in read-only mode, enabling concurrent access while another process holds the write lock.
glossary.spec_dir: The filesystem directory for a given spec, used by `_migrate_legacy_files` to locate legacy markdown files.
glossary.spec_name: The identifier of a spec, passed to `_migrate_legacy_files` to scope the migration.

requirements.title: Make read_only parameter required on open_knowledge_store

user_story.goal: be forced to declare read intent when opening the knowledge store
user_story.benefit: preventing accidental read-write connections and making the convention self-enforcing

acceptance_criteria.action: defines its `read_only` parameter with no default value, so calling it without `read_only` raises a TypeError at call time
retains its existing `read_only` default to remain compatible with internal and test usage
passes an explicit `read_only=True` or `read_only=False` keyword argument

edge_cases.action: raises TypeError immediately before any file I/O is performed
edge_cases.return_contract: TypeError with a message indicating `read_only` is required

requirements.title: Switch af code to read-only database connection

user_story.goal: have the command open knowledge.duckdb in read-only mode
user_story.benefit: allowing it to run concurrently while the nightshift orchestrator holds the write lock

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=True` before executing `load_plan` and `compute_phases`
performs no INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE operations against `knowledge.duckdb`

edge_cases.action: surfaces a clear error message to the user and exits with a non-zero status code
edge_cases.return_contract: non-zero exit code and human-readable error message on stderr
edge_cases.error_condition: `knowledge.duckdb` does not exist at the expected path

requirements.title: Switch af plan --verify to read-only database connection

user_story.goal: have the verify path open knowledge.duckdb in read-only mode
user_story.benefit: allowing plan verification to run concurrently with the orchestrator

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=True`
acceptance_criteria.state: the plan command is executing the verify path (not the save path)

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=False` to allow writes to `plan_nodes`, `plan_edges`, and `plan_meta`
acceptance_criteria.state: the plan command is executing the save path

edge_cases.action: raises a DuckDB read-only exception and exits with a non-zero status code without corrupting the database
edge_cases.return_contract: non-zero exit code and error message identifying the unexpected write attempt
edge_cases.error_condition: a write operation is attempted on the read-only connection opened during the verify path

requirements.title: Switch fix/analyzer.py to read-only database connection

user_story.role: developer or orchestrator invoking the fix analyzer
user_story.goal: have the analyzer open knowledge.duckdb in read-only mode
user_story.benefit: allowing finding queries to proceed concurrently with the orchestrator's write lock

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=True` before executing `query_active_findings`
performs no INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE operations against `knowledge.duckdb`

edge_cases.action: raises a DuckDB read-only exception without silently swallowing it
edge_cases.return_contract: exception propagated to the caller with the original DuckDB error message
edge_cases.error_condition: a write operation is attempted on the read-only connection

requirements.title: Extract _migrate_legacy_files from assemble_context to orchestrator startup

user_story.goal: have legacy file migration run once at startup rather than per session
user_story.benefit: allowing assemble_context to operate with a read-only connection

acceptance_criteria.action: no longer calls `_migrate_legacy_files` under any circumstances
calls `_migrate_legacy_files` with a read-write connection for every spec it will process, before dispatching any sessions
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the `nightshift` orchestrator or engine runner starts up

acceptance_criteria.action: remains idempotent — running it multiple times with the same `spec_dir` and `spec_name` produces no duplicate records and no errors

edge_cases.action: logs the error with spec context and continues processing remaining specs rather than aborting the entire startup
edge_cases.error_condition: `_migrate_legacy_files` fails for one spec due to a missing or malformed legacy file

requirements.title: Extract index_errata_from_markdown from assemble_context to orchestrator startup

user_story.goal: have errata indexing run once at startup rather than per session
user_story.benefit: allowing assemble_context to operate with a read-only connection

acceptance_criteria.action: no longer calls `index_errata_from_markdown` under any circumstances
calls `index_errata_from_markdown` with a read-write connection before dispatching any sessions
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the `nightshift` orchestrator or engine runner starts up

acceptance_criteria.action: remains idempotent — re-indexing the same errata markdown files produces no duplicate records and no errors

edge_cases.action: logs the error and continues startup rather than blocking session dispatch
edge_cases.error_condition: `index_errata_from_markdown` fails due to malformed or missing errata markdown files

requirements.title: Make assemble_context operate exclusively with a read-only connection

user_story.goal: receive a read-only connection when calling assemble_context
user_story.benefit: allowing sessions to read context data concurrently with the orchestrator's write lock

acceptance_criteria.action: retains the `conn` parameter and uses it exclusively for SELECT queries after write operations are extracted
performs zero write operations (no INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE) on the connection it receives
passes a connection opened with `read_only=True` to `assemble_context`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the orchestrator calls `assemble_context` during a session

edge_cases.action: raises a DuckDB read-only exception immediately, surfacing the regression rather than silently failing
edge_cases.return_contract: DuckDB read-only exception propagated to the orchestrator session handler
edge_cases.error_condition: a write operation is inadvertently re-introduced into `assemble_context` and the read-only connection rejects it

requirements.title: Confirm af standup retains read-only connection

user_story.goal: confirm that af standup already uses read_only=True and continues to do so
user_story.benefit: ensuring no regression in concurrent access behavior for the standup command

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=True` and performs only SELECT operations
includes a unit test that asserts `af standup` passes `read_only=True` to `open_knowledge_store`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: test passes as part of `make check`

requirements.title: Keep af findings read-write for dismiss support

user_story.goal: have the findings command retain its read-write connection to support the --dismiss flag
user_story.benefit: avoiding unnecessary complexity from splitting a single command into read/write paths

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=False` to support both SELECT queries and the optional UPDATE performed by --dismiss

requirements.title: All production call sites pass explicit read_only argument

user_story.goal: have every production call site to open_knowledge_store pass an explicit read_only value
user_story.benefit: making connection intent self-documenting and catching mistakes at call time

acceptance_criteria.action: contains no call to `open_knowledge_store` that omits the `read_only` keyword argument in any production module
passes `make check` green after all callers are updated atomically with no deprecation window

edge_cases.action: Python raises TypeError at runtime before any database I/O occurs
edge_cases.return_contract: TypeError with message indicating the missing required keyword argument
edge_cases.error_condition: any future caller omits the `read_only` argument

correctness_properties.title: Read-only call sites never perform writes
correctness_properties.for_any: call site designated as read-only (`af code`, `af plan --verify`, `fix/analyzer.py`, `assemble_context`)
correctness_properties.invariant: the connection passed to or opened by that call site has `read_only=True` and no INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE statement is executed on `knowledge.duckdb` during its lifetime

correctness_properties.title: open_knowledge_store requires explicit read_only on every call
correctness_properties.invariant: `read_only` is always supplied as an explicit keyword argument; omitting it always raises TypeError before any I/O

correctness_properties.title: assemble_context performs zero writes
correctness_properties.invariant: neither `_migrate_legacy_files` nor `index_errata_from_markdown` is called inside `assemble_context`, and the connection it receives is used exclusively for SELECT operations

correctness_properties.title: Idempotency of startup write operations
correctness_properties.for_any: invocation of `_migrate_legacy_files` or `index_errata_from_markdown` at orchestrator startup
correctness_properties.invariant: running either function multiple times with identical inputs produces no duplicate records and no errors in `knowledge.duckdb`

correctness_properties.title: af standup always uses read-only connection
correctness_properties.invariant: `open_knowledge_store` is called with `read_only=True` and no write operation is performed on `knowledge.duckdb`

execution_paths.title: af code displays plan using read-only connection

steps.action: runs `af code` from the CLI
calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=True`
executes `load_plan` and `compute_phases` via SELECT queries on `knowledge.duckdb`
displays the plan output to the developer's terminal and closes the read-only connection

execution_paths.title: af plan --verify checks plan using read-only connection

steps.action: runs `af plan --verify` from the CLI
detects it is on the verify path and calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=True`
executes SELECT queries to load the stored plan for comparison
prints the verification result and exits without writing to `knowledge.duckdb`

execution_paths.title: Orchestrator startup migrates legacy files and indexes errata before sessions

steps.action: starts the `nightshift` or engine runner process
opens `knowledge.duckdb` with `read_only=False` and calls `_migrate_legacy_files` for every spec
calls `index_errata_from_markdown` with the same read-write connection
closes the write connection and begins dispatching sessions
calls `assemble_context` with a read-only connection and reads findings, verdicts, and errata without performing writes

execution_paths.title: fix/analyzer queries active findings using read-only connection

steps.action: invokes `fix/analyzer.py` to analyze active findings
calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=True`
executes `query_active_findings` via SELECT on `knowledge.duckdb`
returns the findings result to the caller and closes the read-only connection

execution_paths.title: af standup displays standup info using existing read-only connection

steps.action: runs `af standup` from the CLI
calls `open_knowledge_store` with `read_only=True` (existing behavior)
executes SELECT queries and returns standup output to the terminal

error_handling.condition: `open_knowledge_store` is called without the `read_only` keyword argument
error_handling.behavior: Python raises TypeError immediately before any file I/O, with a message indicating `read_only` is a required keyword argument

error_handling.condition: `knowledge.duckdb` does not exist when `af code` attempts to open it with `read_only=True`
error_handling.behavior: `af code` surfaces a clear error message to stderr and exits with a non-zero status code

error_handling.condition: A write operation is attempted on the read-only connection opened by `af plan --verify`
error_handling.behavior: DuckDB raises a read-only exception; the command exits with a non-zero status code without corrupting `knowledge.duckdb`

error_handling.condition: A write operation is attempted on the read-only connection opened by `fix/analyzer.py`
error_handling.behavior: The DuckDB read-only exception is propagated to the caller without being swallowed

error_handling.condition: `_migrate_legacy_files` fails for one spec during orchestrator startup due to a missing or malformed legacy file
error_handling.behavior: Orchestrator logs the error with spec context and continues processing remaining specs

error_handling.condition: `index_errata_from_markdown` fails during orchestrator startup due to malformed or missing errata markdown files
error_handling.behavior: Orchestrator logs the error and continues startup rather than blocking session dispatch

error_handling.condition: A write operation is inadvertently re-introduced into `assemble_context` and the read-only connection rejects it
error_handling.behavior: DuckDB read-only exception is propagated immediately to the orchestrator session handler, surfacing the regression

error_handling.condition: A future production caller omits `read_only` when calling `open_knowledge_store`
error_handling.behavior: Python raises TypeError at call time before any database I/O, indicating the missing required keyword argument
